reason: In packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:254-256 (updateEvent) and 315-317 (deleteEvent), the fallback `event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId` only executes when `externalCalendarId` is falsy, so the comparison against `cal.externalId` never matches a valid calendar ID. Consequently, `updateEvent` passes `calendarId: undefined` at line 261 and `deleteEvent` always falls back to `defaultCalendarId` (`"primary"`) at line 322 instead of using the booking's destination calendar.
